areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: General objective directly tied to urban mobility; clear specific objectives, indicators and targets; all components and resources go to rail infrastructure; quantified transformation potential meets maximum standard.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: Link via lower emissions and pollution, but no components or products directly serving the area.

areas.name: Decarbonization
areas.reason: Domestic-manufacture effect of rolling stock is noted, but no components, resources, targets or indicators tied to the area.

areas.name: Labor
areas.reason: Jobs arise only as construction and operation externalities; no resources or components targeting employment of vulnerable residents.

areas.name: Clean energy
areas.reason: Electric rail efficiency is not reflected in objectives, indicators, targets, components or resources.

areas.name: Regional equity
areas.reason: Relevant to intra-municipal inequality, but no specific objectives, indicators, targets or resources; needs better framing in the design.
